categories.name: code_question
categories.short_description: Questions about programming, debugging, or how to write code.
examples: How do I reverse a string in Python?
Why does this React component re-render on every keystroke?
Write me a function to flatten a nested list.

categories.name: factual_question
categories.short_description: Lookup-style questions about real-world facts, history, science, or definitions.
examples: When did the Berlin Wall fall?

categories.name: creative_task
categories.short_description: Requests to produce original written content — stories, poems, brainstorming, marketing copy.
examples: Brainstorm five tagline options for an electric scooter startup.
Draft a short toast for my sister's wedding.

categories.name: math_calculation
categories.short_description: Numerical computation, conversions, or word problems where the user needs a specific number back.
examples: If I save 200 EUR a month at 4% APR, what do I have in 5 years?

categories.name: general_chat
categories.short_description: Greetings, small talk, opinions, or anything that doesn't fit the four buckets above. The catch-all.
